use-nerdfont-icons.description: Enable Nerd Font icons in the UI. Default: true.

image-diffs.description: Render inline image diffs (via the kitty graphics protocol) in the status diff panel on supported terminals. Default: true.

stage-diff-context-lines.description: Number of context lines shown around each diff hunk in the staging view. Clamped to 0–20. Default: 1.

input-modal-bottom.description: Vertical position of the text-input overlay. An integer means fixed lines from the bottom, a percentage string (e.g. "5%") means a fraction of screen height from the bottom, and "center" places it in the middle of the screen. Default: "5%".

oneOf.description: Fixed number of lines from the bottom of the screen.
Percentage of screen height from the bottom (e.g. "5%").
Center the overlay vertically on the screen.

name-aliases.description: Exact full-name aliases used for kitty session names.

max-concurrent-tickets-per-epic.description: Maximum tickets that may run concurrently within one epic. Default: 2.

max-concurrent-epics.description: Maximum epics that may run concurrently in this gx process. Default: 2.

budget.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost soft/hard limits and notification thresholds, in dollars.

soft-limit.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost soft limit in dollars. 0 disables it. Default: 300.

hard-limit.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost hard limit in dollars. 0 disables it. Bumped up to soft-limit if set at or below a nonzero soft-limit. Default: 350.

notification-thresholds.description: Estimated API-equivalent-cost thresholds in dollars at which a notification fires. Sorted and deduped. Default: [50, 100, 150, 200, 250].

important-refs.description: Rules for highlighting important refs in the log view. Refs matching a rule get a bright colored badge; all others get a dim surface badge. Rules are evaluated in order — the first match wins. The order also controls sort priority: refs matching earlier rules appear first.

patterns.description: Regular expressions matched against the full ref name (e.g. "^main$", "^origin/main$", "^v\\d").

color.description: Badge color. Named Catppuccin colors: blue, green, yellow, orange, mauve, teal, red, surface. Or a hex value: #rrggbb or #rgb.

hide-refs.description: Regular expressions matched against the full ref name. Matching refs are hidden from the log view entirely. Takes priority over important-refs. Default: empty (nothing hidden).

telegram.description: Telegram bot credentials for sending notifications. An empty bot-token disables Telegram notifications.

chat-id.description: Telegram chat id to send notifications to. Default: empty.

slack.description: Slack workflow webhook for sending notifications. An empty webhook-url disables Slack notifications.

webhook-url.description: Slack workflow webhook URL (accepts a single {"text": "..."} body). Default: empty (disabled).

skills.description: Which skill(s) gx-implement-equivalent work and code review run under.

implement.description: Skill invoked for ticket-implementation work. Default: gx-implement.

code-review.description: Skill(s) invoked for code review. Default: [thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review].

agents.description: Model and effort level each coding agent runs under. For each field: an absent key uses gx's built-in default; an explicit empty string ("") means "inherit" — gx passes no flag for that knob, leaving the agent CLI's own configuration in charge. Values are passed through as-is (trimmed of surrounding whitespace) and are never validated against a model/effort allowlist.

claude.description: Model/effort for the claude agent. Default: model=sonnet, effort=medium.

model.description: Model passed to the claude CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: sonnet.

effort.description: Effort level passed to the claude CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: medium.

codex.description: Model/effort for the codex agent. Default: model=gpt-5.6-sol, effort=medium.

model.description: Model passed to the codex CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: gpt-5.6-sol.

effort.description: Effort level passed to the codex CLI. Empty string means inherit the CLI's own setting. Default: medium.
